classification.true_success: Every explicit task-local operation, required final UI state, and requested final text is independently satisfied with no prohibited effect.
classification.false_success: Runtime finishes while any required operation/state/text is absent, inherited UI substitutes for a required task-local operation, or the returned value is wrong.
classification.blocked_failure: Runtime does not finish a valid low-risk task and records a recoverable or terminal semantic blocker.
classification.provider_invalid: Provider timeout/error occurs before any task action; report separately.
classification.environment_invalid: External device state changes invalidate the matched run; audit separately and do not relabel after results are known.
